checklist.item: Confirm in-scope contracts, repos, and rules directly on the HackerOne Crypto.com program page and policy.
Extract official Git repository URLs and deployed Ethereum contract addresses listed in scope or linked docs.
Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py on the cloned repos and target addresses with full Slither + Mythril + Aderyn + Halmos passes.
Triage tool output for access-control, reentrancy, oracle, and business-logic issues flagged at high severity.
Manually review core contracts for upgradeability, proxy, and permission patterns not caught by static tools.
Validate any candidate findings against live chain state, recent commits, and actual call flows.
Produce minimal PoC transaction sequence and clear impact statement for each confirmed issue.
Draft report with scope reference, reproduction, and suggested fix then submit via HackerOne.
